authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.

description: "A Message from the Sea" by Charles Dickens is a short story written during the late 19th century (Victorian era). This fictional narrative explores themes of familial bonds, love, and moral integrity as it follows the intertwining lives of a young fisherman, Alfred Raybrock, his beloved Kitty, and Captain Jorgan, who brings unexpected news that sets off a series of transformative events in their lives.
